# Ryan Wigley — ryanwigley.com

> Personal site of Ryan Wigley, an AI-systems builder in Seattle. The site is a
> "Working Exhibit": live systems, tools, and methods pinned to a drafting-table
> canvas. Fifteen years turning complex inputs into reliable outputs — a blog
> read by millions, music-rights tech acquired for $50M (Dubset), APIs at
> billion scale (Amazon), now AI systems that run businesses and premium apps.

Currently: Principal PM at Raya. Side project: Waveform (wavefrm.io), a
browser-based podcast editor. Based in Seattle, WA.

## Pages

- [Home](https://ryanwigley.com/): the exhibit floor — flagship Waveform banner,
  project tiles (Stumble AI, Rain or Rainier?, Acquired Bookshelf, RyOS Starter
  Kit), methodology book, writing tile, the shelf diorama and family crew.
- [Projects](https://ryanwigley.com/projects): the built things. waveform
  (flagship, pre-beta), stumble ai (live), acquired bookshelf (live), rain or
  rainier (live), ryos capsule (install), my skills (repo).
- [Tools](https://ryanwigley.com/tools): the Skill Playbook — hand-built agent
  skills installable via `npx skills add hurleywgly/skills`. Highlights:
  /capsule (agent-ready knowledge transfer), /research, /pitch-me, /daily-brief,
  /ink, /design, /projector, /mine.
- [About](https://ryanwigley.com/about): who Ryan is, how to reach him
  (ryan.wigley522@gmail.com; consulting via productonics.com).
- [Methodology](https://ryanwigley.com/methodology): the operating system —
  "Models change, but the system holds." One personal system spanning home,
  work, and family; it knows him, models plug into it.
- [Writing](https://blog.ryanwigley.com): the blog (external).

## Projects (one-liners)

- Waveform — browser-native podcast editor; the missing middle between
  Audacity's complexity and Descript's opinions. wavefrm.io
- Stumble AI — discover cool AI apps; 50k+ indexed.
- Acquired Bookshelf — every book mentioned on the Acquired podcast,
  auto-catalogued.
- Rain or Rainier? — Seattle's daily question, answered by weather telemetry.
- RyOS Capsule — build-your-own agent OS starter kit.
